title: 23 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Citi Performing Arts Center, Boston, Massachusetts
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Wang Theater, part of the Citi Performing Arts Center, in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, on 23 October 2015.

It was the 33rd show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Thank you Boston you were great and the band was great love peace and love I had a great time I know you did ??????????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 24, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion

We had the band dinner tonight in Boston peace and love peace and love I love this band ?????????? pic.twitter.com/LUhcxFxoOG

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 23, 2015
